title: Chapter 293: The Ultimate Arms Battlefield Show
content:
Chapter 293: The Ultimate Arms Battlefield Show

The six-star Zerg Mammoths were rampaging on the battlefield, not to kill as many enemies as possible, but to break through the enemy's defenses, open a gap, and let the Zerg Puppies rush in.

The Zerg Puppies were the ones who really massacred the alien army on a large scale.

As long as the Zerg Puppies rushed into the alien army in the plague area, the alien army's long-range attacks would be ineffective against them, and they could kill the alien army that had basically lost its combat effectiveness.

The Zerg six-star Mammoths were like high-speed bulldozers, paving the way for the Zerg Puppies, cutting the alien army into pieces, and allowing the Zerg Puppies to encircle and slaughter.

The Zerg six-star Scorpions constantly used the elimination of enemies to restore energy and skill status, and continued to release plagues to expand the plague infection area in the alien army.

The ten positions selected by the Queen were all accurately calculated. The attacks of the alien army in these ten positions were blocked, and the ground offensive of the entire alien army immediately weakened.

As long as the aliens can't find the source of the Zerg Scorpion, the plague of the Zerg Scorpion will make the alien army's attack fail.

The attack range of the six-star Zerg Scorpion, like the Zerg Queen, is very far. It is like looking for a needle in a haystack to find a Zerg Scorpion that can burrow into the ground at any time among the countless Zerg puppies.

Above the six-star Zerg Scorpion, there is a Zerg host that is always paying attention to the situation around it. If it finds that the situation is not good, it will notify the Zerg Scorpion to burrow into the ground.

"Another new Zerg troop has been deployed on the battlefield! It is also a powerful giant melee troop!"

"I originally thought that the Zerg's melee troop was a weakness, but I didn't expect that a powerful melee troop would only appear now!"

"The Zerg has only deployed a handful of new melee troop types on the battlefield. It is conceivable that the Zerg has confidence in this troop type!"

"With such a size, such strength, and such a strong defense, the alien army on the battlefield really can't do anything to them!"

"They cooperate with the Zerg's mysterious large-scale battlefield magic and the large-scale melee troop types, which is really a weapon to cut the attack formation of the alien army!"

"The Zerg has taken out two trump cards again, and the battlefield situation is about to change again!"

"Let's see what other countermeasures the Zerg has!"

"..."

The spectators from all forces in the local camp can only see the six-star Zerg Mammoth with strong melee strength. They regard the plague attack of the six-star Zerg Scorpion as a large-scale battlefield magic of the Zerg.

The plague and black bees of the Zerg scorpion are indeed somewhat similar to the large-scale battlefield magic in this world.

The ground offensive of the alien army was affected, and Wu Qing turned his attention to the aerial battlefield.

For the aerial battlefield, Wu Qing gathered a group of Zerg dragons together to block the outside world's view, and evolved 4,000 of them into five-star Zerg Devourers.

The reason why Wu Qing chose to evolve and upgrade 4,000 Zerg Devourers instead of continuing to evolve and upgrade Zerg air guards was because he found in actual combat that the terrible mucus sprayed by the Zerg Devourer fell on the ground of the alien army, and the killing effect caused was not weaker than the air attack, and even better.

This is actually easy to understand. The mucus attack sprayed by the Zerg Devourer has such a powerful air killing power in the setting. This mucus cannot fail to play a role when it falls on the ground troops.

This is the real world, not the game world, and many things must conform to common sense.

Of course, there is also a possibility that all Zerg arms are designed for the space environment. There is no air in space, so the mucus sprayed by the Zerg Devourer will not fall, which is logical.

But in this world, the mucus sprayed by the Zerg Devourer will fall to the ground. As long as the flight altitude and attack angle are controlled, the Zerg Devourer can accurately attack the ground.

Now the Zerg army no longer needs to increase the long-range attack power beyond visual range, so Wu Qing gave all the resources originally intended for the Zerg Air Guard to the Zerg Devourer.

The Zerg Devourer can fight air battles and then provide ground support without delay.

Four thousand five-star Zerg Devourers were upgraded at one time, increasing the number of five-star Zerg Devourers to five thousand.

When four thousand five-star Zerg Devourers suddenly appeared in the Zerg Dragon Group, everyone was stunned and didn't know how they appeared.

"How did so many new Zerg soldiers appear? Teleportation or evolution?"

"Either they have a mobile teleportation array that is almost impossible to exist, or they are Zerg army soldiers that can be upgraded and evolved. These are all incredible abilities!"

"It's incredible!"

"..."

Five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers showed the power of the overlord of the sky. They were scattered, each responsible for a certain air combat area, constantly spraying terrible mucus attacks, and coordinating with Zerg dragons. The flying soldiers of the aliens simply couldn't rush over.

A large number of flying soldiers of the aliens disappeared under the super corrosive mucus of the Zerg Devourers. More flying soldiers of the aliens were affected by the invisible special spores, and their attack and defense dropped rapidly, and they were easily destroyed by the Zerg dragons around the Zerg Devourers.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers were deployed on the air battlefield, and soon suppressed the offensive of the flying soldiers of the aliens.

The Zerg Devourer and the Zerg Dragon work together, and there is no opponent in the air battle.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

With the addition of the Zerg Devourer, the Zerg air mobile force no longer needs the support of the ground air defense force. They began to take the initiative to attack and destroy the air forces of the aliens.

The flying arms of various races accumulated by the alien army were invested at one time, hoping to break through the defense line of the Zerg army from the air. Unfortunately, this plan was destroyed by 5,000 five-star Zerg Devourers.

The flying arms of various races of the alien army cannot compare with the five-star Zerg Devourer in terms of the range of long-range attacks, even the five-star Griffin of Light cannot.

As long as the five-star Zerg Devourer is swung in front of the Zerg air mobile force, the flying arms of the alien army can basically not rush over.

The flying troops of the alien race, which were attacked by the five-star Zerg Devourer's area-killing slime, were either killed directly or infected by the special spores flying around in the slime, and their combat power was greatly reduced, leaving them at the mercy of others.

The Zerg air mobile force, with such a lineup, flew out of the air defense area of the Zerg main combat troops for the first time and attacked the air troops of the alien army.

The Zerg air mobile force stopped only after advancing to the attack range of the long-range attack troops of the alien ground troops.

At this time, the air troops of the alien race, which suffered heavy losses, no longer dared to fly over to fight with the Zerg air mobile troops.

Flying troops, no matter which race they are, are relatively rare and precious troops, and the alien race will not easily waste flying troops.

At this time, the Zerg air mobile force flying over the ground vanguard troops of the alien army immediately launched an attack on the ground to assist the defense of the Zerg ground main combat troops.

The ranged attack arms of the alien race that were stuck in the range began to speed up, trying to move forward and attack the Zerg's air mobile forces.

Without the support of the Zerg Destroyer, 5,000 five-star Zerg Devourers lowered their flight altitude a little and aimed at the ranged attack arms of the alien army's ground forces in the distance, spraying 5,000 balls of terrible mucus.

The mucus balls flew at high speed, and when they arrived at the target area, they scattered and splashed everywhere like the Zerg biodegradation liquid sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisk, falling on the ranged attack arms of the alien army like rain.

The size of the five-star Zerg Devourer is much larger than that of the Zerg Hydralisk, and it is a big circle. The amount of mucus they spray is quite substantial.

The super corrosive liquid sprayed by the five-star Zerg Devourer is simply not something that the alien long-range attack arms of the general one-star strength can withstand.

The long-range attack arms of the alien army that are launching the attack have suffered large-scale casualties for the first time, in addition to the attack of the Zerg Destroyer.

If it was just a loss of personnel, the alien army could still bear it. What was more terrifying was that the dense alien army, as long as it was close to the attack area of the five-star Zerg Devourer, was gradually losing its combat effectiveness, and its strong defense capability was also rapidly weakening.

The attack of the five-star Zerg Devourer was more terrifying than the attack of the five-star Zerg Destroyer. It not only directly eliminated a large number of enemies, but also made more enemies lose combat effectiveness, move slowly, and reduce defense. This was more influential than directly eliminating them. With them blocking in front, the friendly forces attacking from the rear would be seriously affected.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers fine-tuned the attack angle and continued to attack the ground forces of the alien army that were attacking fiercely, which soon brought this wave of offensive of the alien army to a standstill.

The vanguard troops of the alien army's ground attack were infected with special spores in large numbers, blocking the subsequent continuous offensive of the alien army.

"This new Zerg troop is not only the overlord of the air, but also has a strong ground attack effect!"

"Their ground attack now has a miraculous effect!"

"Through the situation of the ground forces of the alien human army, it can now be confirmed that the attack of this new Zerg troop also has a terrible ability to greatly reduce the combat power and defense of surrounding enemies!"

"With the addition of this new troop, the Zerg air force is enough to roam freely on the public battlefield!"

"If the new Zerg flying troop with ultra-long-range attack is added, it will be difficult for the Zerg to encounter opponents if it only sends out air troops in the future!"

"This Zerg has a deep foundation! I wonder what stronger troop will appear in the future!"

"..."

The spectators from various forces in the local camp are already imagining the lineup of the Zerg's new air force.
